en.name: Vegetables
en.subtitle: Leafy greens, roots and everyday vegetables — how to choose and store them.

zh.name: 蔬菜
zh.subtitle: 葉菜、根莖與日常蔬菜——挑選與保存要訣。

en.name: Leafy greens
en.desc: Bok choy, spinach, A-choy and the like — quick-cooking and perishable. Stir-fry, blanch, or drop into soup.
tip: Don't wash before storing — wash just before you cook.

Best in a cloth produce bag (the 'soy-milk bag' from hardware stores): drop the greens in unwashed, fold the top over and refrigerate — spinach, sweet-potato leaves and the rest keep two or even three weeks. The cloth breathes and absorbs moisture better than a paper-towel wrap; newspaper works too, but the ink makes it a last resort.

Meal-prep alternative: wash and cut everything the day you shop, then keep the pieces in a lidded container lined — and topped — with a wrung-out wet cloth, so condensation from the lid never drips onto the leaves: grab-and-cook for 4–5 days. Chop and freeze whatever you won't get to (2–3 weeks); frozen greens go straight into soup, no washing or cutting.

zh.name: 葉菜類
zh.desc: 小白菜、菠菜、A 菜之類——易熟也易壞。快炒、汆燙或入湯皆宜。
tip: 保存前不清洗，下鍋前再洗。
首選豆漿袋（五金行買得到的棉布袋）：青菜不洗直接放入、折好袋口冷藏——菠菜、地瓜葉等葉菜可放兩週甚至三週。布袋透氣又吸濕，比紙巾包更好；報紙也行，但有油墨，不得已再用。
備餐派做法：買回當天全部洗淨、切成好用的大小，放進保鮮盒，底部鋪、上方也蓋一層擰乾的濕布——上層擋住盒蓋凝結的水珠滴到菜葉：隨取隨煮可放 4～5 天。用不完的切段冷凍（2～3 週），煮湯直接下鍋，免洗免切。

en.name: Cabbage
en.desc: Sweet, crunchy and versatile — Taiwan's everyday cabbage. Stir-fry, braise, or shred raw.
tip: Keep the loose outer leaves on as a wrapper. Turn the head over and cut a deep cross into the core — or stab in a few bamboo skewers, or hollow the core out entirely and press a wet paper towel into the cavity to keep the head hydrated — so the core stops feeding on the leaves and the head stays fresh longer.
Then keep it whole and unwashed in a cloth produce bag with a paper towel inside to absorb moisture, in the crisper. Wrap cut faces in plastic and use within days.

zh.name: 高麗菜
zh.desc: 清甜爽脆、用途廣，是台灣的日常高麗菜。快炒、滷煮或生切涼拌皆可。
tip: 外層老葉別剝，留著當保護層。整顆翻過來，在菜芯上深深劃十字——或插入幾支竹籤，也可以整個挖除菜芯、塞入濕紙巾補水——讓菜芯停止吸取葉片養分，整顆更耐放。
接著整顆不清洗，裝豆漿袋（棉布袋）並放一張廚房紙巾吸濕，置於蔬果室。切開後切面包好，數日內食用。

en.name: Napa cabbage
en.desc: Sweet, tender Chinese cabbage — the base of hot pot, braised napa (白菜滷) and dumpling fillings.
en.tip: Store exactly like cabbage: keep the outer leaves, cut a deep cross into the core (or pierce it with bamboo skewers) so it stops drawing nutrients from the leaves, then refrigerate in a cloth produce bag with a paper towel inside to absorb moisture.

zh.name: 大白菜
zh.desc: 清甜軟嫩的白菜，火鍋、白菜滷與水餃餡的基底。
zh.tip: 與高麗菜作法相同：留外葉、菜芯深劃十字（或插竹籤）使其停止吸取葉片養分，裝豆漿袋（棉布袋）並放一張廚房紙巾吸濕後冷藏。

en.name: Broccoli
en.desc: Dense green florets — blanch, stir-fry or roast; a weight-loss staple.
tip: Soak it head-down in water and shake to flush out the bugs that hide in the florets, then dry the head well — dampness is what rots it. Stick a toothpick into the cut stem end (it stops the head from growing on and aging), wrap in a dry cloth or paper towel, bag it and refrigerate: about a week depending on freshness.
To keep it longer, cut into florets and freeze (about a month) — the texture softens, so frozen broccoli is best in soup.

zh.name: 青花菜
zh.desc: 緊實的綠色花球——汆燙、快炒或烘烤皆宜，減脂餐常客。
tip: 花球朝下泡水搖晃，把躲在花球裡的小蟲沖出來，之後務必把花球擦乾——受潮正是腐壞主因。在莖部切口插一根牙籤（讓它停止繼續生長老化），用乾布或紙巾包好、裝袋冷藏，依新鮮度約可放一週。
想放更久就切小朵冷凍（約一個月）——口感會變軟，冷凍青花菜最適合煮湯。

en.name: Daikon radish
en.desc: Large white winter radish, mild and juicy. Simmers into soups and braises, or pickles crisp.
tip: Room temperature: trim off the green tops as soon as you get home so they don't keep drawing out moisture, then keep the radish whole and unwashed in a cool, airy spot — about 3–5 days in winter or an air-conditioned room (under 20°C), but only 1–2 days in humid summer heat (25–30°C+). Daikon is very watery and goes spongy or soft from the inside in summer warmth.

Refrigerator: if you won't cook it within two days, peel it, cut into chunks, seal in a bag with the air pressed out and refrigerate — about a month in the crisper. Don't freeze whole (it turns mushy); grated is fine.

zh.name: 白蘿蔔
zh.desc: 冬季大型白蘿蔔，清甜多汁。燉湯、滷煮，或醃漬成爽脆小菜。
tip: 室溫保存：買回後立刻切除頂部綠葉，以免葉子持續抽走水分；整條不清洗、置於陰涼通風處——冬季或冷氣房（20°C 以下）約可放 3～5 天，夏季悶熱（25～30°C 以上）最多 1～2 天。白蘿蔔水分高，夏季室溫下易從內部變糠（空心）或變軟。
冷藏：若兩天內煮不完，建議削皮切段、裝夾鏈袋擠出空氣冷藏，可存約一個月。整條勿冷凍（易軟爛），磨成泥則可。

en.name: Carrot
en.desc: Sweet orange root, good raw or cooked. Adds color and sweetness to stir-fries, soups and stews.
tip: Room temperature: cut off the green tops as soon as you get home, or the leaves keep pulling moisture and nutrients out and the whole carrot quickly goes limp. Keep them dry — don't wash or store them wet; if there's soil on them, just wrap them in newspaper or paper towel and keep them in a cool, airy box or basket. About 5–7 days in winter or an air-conditioned room (under 20°C), but only 2–3 days in humid summer heat (25–30°C+), when Taiwan's damp molds the tops and dries the skin black. Carrots are sensitive to ethylene, so keep them away from apples and tomatoes or they turn bitter.

Refrigerator: if you have a lot or it's hot, pat them dry, wrap in newspaper and refrigerate — 2–4 weeks. Trimming both the top and the tail end first stops the root from growing on and keeps it firm past a week.
Freezer (about 2 months): dice into soup-sized pieces and freeze in a bag — straight into the pot, no thawing, and weekday soups get much easier.

zh.name: 紅蘿蔔
zh.desc: 橙色甜味根菜，生熟皆宜。為快炒、湯品與燉菜增色添甜。
tip: 室溫保存：買回後立刻切除頂端青綠色的莖葉，否則葉子會持續抽走全身的水分與養分，整條很快乾癟軟塌。保持乾燥、不要帶水或清洗；表面有泥土時直接用報紙或廚房紙巾包好，放在陰涼通風的紙箱或竹籃裡。冬季或冷氣房（20°C 以下）約可放 5～7 天，夏季悶熱（25～30°C 以上）大約只能放 2～3 天，台灣濕熱環境下頂端易發霉、表皮也會乾硬發黑。紅蘿蔔對乙烯敏感，勿與蘋果、番茄等同放，否則易產生苦味。
冷藏：量多或天熱、預計 3 天內吃不完時，建議擦乾、用報紙包好冷藏，可存 2～4 週。先把頭尾兩端切除，能讓它停止繼續生長，放超過一週依然硬挺。
冷凍（約兩個月）：切成煮湯用的小丁裝袋冷凍——下鍋免解凍，平日煮湯輕鬆許多。

en.name: Potato
en.desc: A starchy all-rounder. Boil, mash, fry or stew — it soaks up flavor and turns creamy.
tip: Room temperature (1–3 months): if your home is dry, put them in a dark paper bag with an apple and keep it somewhere cool, airy and out of sunlight — the ethylene the apple gives off slows sprouting.
Refrigerator (1–2 weeks): if your home is humid, store them in a perforated plastic bag in the fridge, away from light so they don't sprout.
Freezer (about 1 month): peel and cut into chunks, steam soft in the rice cooker, mash, and seal in a freezer bag for later use.
Why it matters: potatoes sprout when exposed to light, big temperature swings or long storage, producing toxic solanine — so never eat ones that have turned green or sprouted.

zh.name: 馬鈴薯
zh.desc: 百搭的澱粉根莖。水煮、搗泥、油炸或燉煮皆宜，易吸味、口感綿密。
tip: 常溫保存（1～3 個月）：家中環境較乾燥時，與一顆蘋果一同裝進深色紙袋，放在照不到陽光的通風陰涼處——蘋果釋放的乙烯氣體能減緩發芽。
冷藏保存（1～2 週）：家中環境較潮濕時，裝進打洞的塑膠袋內冷藏，並避免照光以免發芽。
冷凍保存（約 1 個月）：去皮切塊放入電鍋蒸熟，壓成泥裝入保鮮袋冷凍，供日後使用。
為什麼要注意：馬鈴薯照到光線、溫度變化劇烈或儲藏過久就會發芽，產生有毒的龍葵鹼，因此變綠或發芽的馬鈴薯不可食用。

en.name: Sweet potato
en.desc: Sweet, dense root with orange or yellow flesh. Steam, bake or fry; the leaves are eaten too.
en.tip: Cool, dark and airy; never refrigerate — cold turns them hard and off-flavored.

zh.name: 地瓜
zh.desc: 香甜紮實的根莖，橙肉或黃肉。蒸、烤或炸皆宜；地瓜葉也可食用。
zh.tip: 陰涼、避光、通風；切勿冷藏，低溫會使其變硬走味。

en.name: Shiitake mushroom
en.desc: Meaty, savory fresh mushrooms for sautés, stews and soups. For the dried kind, see Kitchen Staples.
tip: Never wash — water washes the aroma away and turns them slimy. Wipe the caps with a wrung-out damp cloth or paper towel, and keep them in a paper bag (not plastic) in the fridge for about a week.
Freezer (about 3 months): slice raw into strips, seal in a freezer bag and cook straight from frozen — freezing breaks down the cell walls, so they actually release more umami in the pan.
Bonus: an hour of sunshine on the gills before storing boosts their vitamin D.

zh.name: 香菇
zh.desc: 肉厚味鮮，煎炒、燉煮或入湯皆宜。乾香菇請見「廚房常備」。
tip: 切勿水洗——香菇一碰水香氣流失又容易變滑爛。用擰乾的濕布或紙巾把蕈傘擦乾淨，裝紙袋（勿用塑膠袋）冷藏約可放一週。
冷凍（約三個月）：生香菇切絲或切片直接裝袋冷凍，下鍋免解凍——冷凍會破壞細胞壁，煮的時候鮮味反而釋放得更多。
加分技：保存前把蕈褶朝上晒約一小時太陽，維生素 D 會增加。

en.name: Enoki mushroom
en.desc: Long, thin and springy white mushrooms — for hot pot, soups and chilled dressed dishes (涼拌).
tip: Keep sealed in the original pack in the fridge and use within the week — enoki hates moisture and cold damage, and freezing ruins its texture.

Best move is to cook it the day you buy it: snip off the root end while it's still in the bag, rinse, drain well, then microwave (600W, about 2 minutes) or blanch and season lightly with salt and sesame oil. This make-ahead side keeps 4–5 days refrigerated and drops straight into miso soup, dressings or stir-fries.

zh.name: 金針菇
zh.desc: 細長白嫩、口感滑脆——火鍋、湯品與涼拌的常客。
tip: 原包裝密封冷藏、一週內用完——金針菇怕濕氣也怕凍傷，冷凍後口感會變差，不建議。
最推薦買回當天就處理：連袋切除根部、沖洗瀝乾，微波（600W 約 2 分鐘）或汆燙後，以少許鹽和香油拌勻調味。這道常備小菜冷藏可放 4～5 天，直接吃、加進味噌湯、涼拌或快炒都方便。

en.name: Shimeji mushroom
en.desc: Small brown-capped clusters that stay bouncy when cooked — for stir-fries, soups, hot pot and mixed-mushroom rice.
tip: Don't wash — wipe if needed.
Freezer: if you won't use it within a few days, cut off the woody base, break into small clusters and freeze raw in a bag — it cooks straight from frozen and the umami actually deepens.
Or microwave it with shiitake and maitake, seasoned with a little salt, vinegar and olive oil, into a marinated-mushroom side that keeps 4–5 days in the fridge.

zh.name: 鴻喜菇
zh.desc: 褐色小傘成叢，煮後依然彈脆——快炒、湯品、火鍋與什菇炊飯都合適。
tip: 不水洗，必要時擦拭即可。
冷凍：幾天內用不到就切除根部、剝成小朵直接生凍裝袋——下鍋免解凍，鮮味反而更濃。
也可以和香菇、舞菇一起微波，用少許鹽、醋、橄欖油拌成醃漬什菇常備菜，冷藏可放 4～5 天。

en.name: Maitake mushroom
en.desc: Frilly, deeply savory mushroom — great pan-seared, in soups or folded into rice.
tip: The quickest-spoiling of the common mushrooms — if you won't cook it within a day or two, tear it into pieces and freeze it raw.
Or heat it right away (microwave with a little salt, vinegar and olive oil) as a marinated side for the week.

zh.name: 舞菇
zh.desc: 皺褶花瓣狀、鮮味濃郁——乾煎、煮湯或拌進炊飯都出色。
tip: 常見菇類中最不耐放——一兩天內煮不到，就撕成小朵直接生凍。
或立刻加熱處理（與少許鹽、醋、橄欖油微波拌勻），做成一週份的醃菇常備菜。

en.name: Bean sprouts
en.desc: Cheap, crisp and nutritious — for stir-fries, blanched salads and noodle soups.
en.tip: The fastest-spoiling vegetable in the basket — in the store bag they barely last a day or two. Wash thoroughly, drain, then refrigerate fully submerged in drinking water in a sealed bag or container; change the water every 2 days and they stay crisp for 3–7 days depending on freshness.

zh.name: 豆芽菜
zh.desc: 便宜、爽脆又營養——快炒、汆燙涼拌與湯麵都好用。
zh.tip: 菜籃裡最容易壞的蔬菜——原袋冷藏頂多放一兩天。徹底洗淨、瀝乾後，放進密封袋或保鮮盒，加入蓋過豆芽的飲用水冷藏；每兩天換一次水，依新鮮度可脆放 3～7 天。

en.name: Green beans
en.desc: Crisp green pods for dry-fried beans, stir-fries and simmered dishes — they bring crunch and color.
tip: A summer vegetable that suffers from both dryness and fridge cold, so the standard prep is to blanch it the day you buy it: trim the ends, boil in salted water for 20–30 seconds, shock in ice water and drain. Kept on a dry paper towel in a sealed container they're grab-and-go for salads, stir-fries and lunch boxes for a few days.
Freeze the blanched beans (about a month) for longer.

zh.name: 四季豆
zh.desc: 翠綠爽脆的豆莢，乾煸、快炒與燉煮皆宜，添脆又添色。
tip: 四季豆是夏季蔬菜，怕乾燥也怕冷藏低溫，標準做法是買回當天就汆燙：去頭尾，入加鹽滾水燙 20～30 秒，撈起冰鎮瀝乾。保鮮盒鋪乾廚房紙巾吸走多餘水分後冷藏，涼拌、快炒、帶便當隨取隨用，數日內吃完。
想放更久就把燙好的豆子冷凍（約一個月）。

en.name: Okra
en.desc: Green pods with a silky, mucilaginous bite — blanched with soy sauce, in soups, or piled on cold tofu.
tip: Okra hates the cold and keeps poorly raw in the fridge, so deal with it the day you buy it. Wipe dry, pare just the rim of the stem cap (don't cut into the pod), blanch in salted water about 20 seconds, shock in ice water — then eat within a couple of days.
Freeze the rest raw: slice into thin rounds, spread flat in a freezer bag so they don't clump, and they keep about a month — thaw briefly and they're ready to eat as-is, no cooking needed.

zh.name: 秋葵
zh.desc: 口感滑黏的綠色豆莢——汆燙淋醬油、入湯或鋪在冷豆腐上都對味。
tip: 秋葵怕冷又不耐生放冷藏，買回當天就處理。擦乾後削去蒂頭邊緣一圈（別切進果莢），入加鹽滾水汆燙約 20 秒、撈起冰鎮——兩三天內吃完。
吃不完的生凍：切成薄圓片，平鋪裝進冷凍袋以免結塊，約可放一個月——稍微解凍即可直接吃，免加熱。

en.name: Corn
en.desc: Sweet yellow kernels on the cob. Boil, grill or steam; cut the kernels for soups, stir-fries and fried rice.
tip: Room temperature (≤2 days): keep it under about 25°C, out of direct sun and not piled up; the sugars turn starchy fast, so cook it as soon as you can.
Refrigerator (≤7 days): keep it in the husk and bag it so it doesn't dehydrate. Don't leave it loose and chilled for long — the cold air pulls the moisture out and the kernels go dry and shriveled.

Freezer (about 6 months): rinse, cut into recipe-sized chunks, portion into freezer bags and freeze — next time cook straight from frozen, no thawing. Or cut the kernels off, season with a little salt, sugar and water in a box, and steam in the rice cooker for your own canned-style corn.

zh.name: 玉米
zh.desc: 金黃香甜的玉米，連軸水煮、燒烤或蒸；剝粒則可入湯、快炒或炒飯。
tip: 室溫保存（不超過 2 天）：置於約 25°C 以下，避免日晒與堆積；甜分很快轉為澱粉，宜盡速烹調。
冷藏保存（不超過 7 天）：連葉並用塑膠袋包裝以免脫水。別不包裝久放冷藏，冷氣會把水分抽走，玉米粒變得乾扁。
冷凍保存（約半年）：洗淨後切成適合料理的大小，用保鮮袋分裝冷凍，下次不用解凍就能直接下鍋。或把玉米粒切下，放保鮮盒加少許鹽、糖、水，用電鍋蒸熟，自製玉米罐頭。

en.name: Baby corn
en.desc: Tiny immature cobs eaten whole — tender, mildly sweet and fully edible. For stir-fries, hot pot and blanched salads.
en.tip: Refrigerate in a bag; eat within a few days while crisp.

zh.name: 玉米筍
zh.desc: 幼嫩的小玉米，整支可食、清甜爽脆。快炒、火鍋或汆燙涼拌皆宜。
zh.tip: 裝袋冷藏，趁脆數日內食用。

en.name: Beef tomato
en.desc: Large, meaty, low-sweetness tomato treated as a cooking vegetable in Taiwan. The base for tomato-and-egg stir-fry (番茄炒蛋), tomato beef soup and stews.
tip: Room temperature: Best (3–7 days). Keep it on a cool, airy counter out of direct sun, sitting stem-side down — the stem end is hardest and the flesh thickest, so this eases pressure on the bottom and keeps it from softening or weeping, and blocks air at the stem scar. Ripening tomatoes give off a lot of ethylene, so don't bag or basket them with leafy greens, potatoes or carrots, or those rot and sprout fast.

Refrigerator: Last resort (7–10 days). Chill only once it's deep red and soft, or after you've cut it — cold under 5°C breaks down the cell walls and aroma, turning the flesh mealy and bland. If you must, pat it dry, wrap it alone in newspaper or paper towel, put it stem-side down in a bag and keep it in the warmer crisper drawer; let it warm ~20 minutes before eating to recover some flavor.

Freezer: For when you can't use them up (1–2 months). Wash, dry and de-stem whole, then freeze — they can't be eaten raw, but for tomato-and-egg stir-fry, tomato beef soup or sauce, rinse a frozen one under water and the skin slips right off.

zh.name: 牛番茄
zh.desc: 大顆、肉厚、甜度低，在台灣多當作料理用的蔬菜。番茄炒蛋、番茄牛肉湯與燉菜的基底。
tip: 室溫保存：最推薦（3～7 天）。放陰涼、通風、避免陽光直射的檯面，且「蒂頭朝下」擺放——蒂頭硬、果肉厚，朝下能減少底部受壓變軟出水，也擋住空氣進入蒂頭縫隙。番茄熟成會釋放大量乙烯，別與葉菜、馬鈴薯、紅蘿蔔放同一袋或籃，否則周邊蔬果易腐爛或發芽。
冷藏：最後手段（7～10 天）。只在已轉深紅、摸起來變軟或切剩時才冰；低溫（5°C 以下）會破壞細胞壁與香氣，冰過果肉變粉、香甜流失。要冰就擦乾表面、單獨用報紙或紙巾包好、蒂頭朝下放保鮮袋，置於溫度較高的蔬果室；食用前先回溫約 20 分鐘可找回一點風味。
冷凍：吃不完的終極大招（1～2 個月）。洗淨、擦乾、去蒂後整顆冷凍，雖不能生吃，但煮番茄炒蛋、番茄牛肉湯或熬醬時取出沖水，外皮一秒就能剝除。

en.name: Zucchini
en.alt: 櫛瓜 / 夏南瓜 / 翠玉瓜
en.desc: Mild summer squash with tender, edible skin. Slice for stir-fries, soups and grills, or spiralize — it cooks fast and soaks up flavor.
tip: Room temperature: only in a cool, airy spot and for a day or two at most — Taiwan's summer humidity (25–30°C+) softens and rots it fast, so the fridge is the default here.

Refrigerator: best (about 7–10 days). Keep it whole and unwashed, pat off any surface moisture, and store it loose in a perforated or loosely-closed bag in the crisper — trapped water is what turns the skin slimy. Don't wash until you cook, and wrap the cut face of a used one and finish it within a couple of days.

zh.name: 櫛瓜
zh.desc: 溫和的夏季瓜類，皮薄細嫩可連皮食用。切片快炒、入湯、煎烤或刨成麵條皆宜，易熟又容易吸味。
tip: 室溫保存：僅限陰涼通風處，最多放 1～2 天——台灣夏季濕熱（25～30°C 以上）會讓櫛瓜很快變軟腐爛，因此這裡建議直接冷藏。
冷藏：最推薦（約 7～10 天）。整條不清洗、擦乾表面水分，鬆裝於打孔袋或不密封的塑膠袋放入蔬果室——殘留水氣正是表皮發黏腐爛的主因。烹煮前再清洗；切開後切面包好，數日內食用完畢。

en.name: Cucumber
en.desc: Crisp and cooling — for smacked-cucumber salads, quick pickles and stir-fries.
en.tip: Don't wash, and don't trim the ends — cucumbers are full of water and cut ends weep. Put them in a cloth produce bag or plastic bag, always with a sheet of paper towel inside to absorb moisture, and refrigerate; about two weeks.

zh.name: 小黃瓜
zh.desc: 清脆爽口，拍黃瓜、涼拌、醃漬與快炒皆宜。
zh.tip: 不清洗，也不建議切除頭尾——小黃瓜水分多，切口容易出水。裝豆漿袋（棉布袋）或塑膠袋，務必放一張廚房紙巾吸濕，冷藏約可放兩週。

en.name: Loofah
en.desc: Silky Taiwanese gourd that cooks down sweet and tender — stir-fried with clams, in soups, or steamed.
en.tip: Don't wash — just cut off the stem end. Wrap in paper towel first, then a layer of aluminum foil (shiny or matte side, either way): the foil chills it quickly while the paper absorbs excess moisture. Keeps about two weeks in the fridge.

zh.name: 絲瓜
zh.desc: 軟甜多汁的瓜類，炒蛤蜊、煮湯或清蒸都合適。
zh.tip: 不清洗，只切除蒂頭。先用廚房紙巾包好，外層再包一層鋁箔紙（亮面霧面皆可）——鋁箔導冷快，內層紙巾吸走多餘水氣，冷藏約可放兩週。

en.name: Winter melon
en.desc: Mild, watery melon usually sold by the slice; melts into soups and braises.
tip: Refrigerator (about 1 week): wrap the slice in paper towel, then a plastic bag.
Freezer: peel, seed and cube, then freeze — frozen winter melon softens faster in soup and releases its flavor into the broth more readily.

zh.name: 冬瓜
zh.desc: 多以切片販售，清淡多水，入湯燉煮易軟入味。
tip: 冷藏（約一週）：切片用廚房紙巾包好，再裝塑膠袋冷藏。
冷凍：去皮去籽切塊冷凍——凍過的冬瓜煮湯更快軟爛，也更容易把風味釋放到湯裡。

en.name: Pumpkin
en.desc: Dense, sweet squash for soups, steaming, braises and pumpkin rice noodles (金瓜米粉).
tip: Whole and uncut: a cool, dark, airy spot keeps it a month or more.

The knife-friendly prep: wash the skin, microwave the whole squash to soften the hard shell (600W, about 4 minutes — wrap it in a wet cloth or cover it in a heatproof bowl), then scoop out the seeds with a spoon while warm (careful, hot!) and cut into use-sized pieces. Boxed in the fridge, they're grab-and-cook for 3–4 days — five-minute stews, soups or salads.
Skip the freezer — raw pumpkin turns watery and bland after freezing; if you must, steam and mash it first.

zh.name: 南瓜
zh.desc: 厚實香甜的瓜類，煮湯、清蒸、燉煮與金瓜米粉都合適。
tip: 整顆未切：陰涼、避光、通風處可放一個月以上。
好切訣竅：外皮洗淨，整顆微波把硬皮軟化（600W 約 4 分鐘，包上濕布或放耐熱碗加蓋），趁熱用湯匙挖籽（小心燙！），再切成料理用大小。裝保鮮盒冷藏，3～4 天內隨取隨煮——五分鐘就能變出燉菜、湯品或沙拉。
不建議冷凍——生南瓜凍過口感變得水爛無味；真要冷凍，先蒸熟壓成泥再凍。
